questions.stem: Explain the 2019 South finding about religion and society.

answer.exemplar: A 2019 survey of 3000 working mothers in the American South found 65% attended services weekly, while 15% rarely or never attended. A complete response names the concept, defines it, and supports the definition with the contrasting shares in the data.

stimulus.body: A 2022 survey of 3600 working mothers in the American South found 79% attended services weekly, while 21% rarely or never attended.

questions.stem: Which concept fits the 2022 South religion and society finding?

options.text: The 2022 South pattern illustrates secularization.
options.misconception: assumes belief disappears entirely in modern life

options.text: The 2022 South pattern illustrates denomination.
options.misconception: confuses a branch with the entire tradition

options.text: The 2022 South pattern illustrates ritual.
options.misconception: reduces a collective rite to a personal habit

options.text: The 2022 South pattern illustrates religion.

questions.explanation: A system of shared beliefs and practices about the sacred. The 2022 data from the American South (79% versus 21%) fit this reading; the alternatives describe different mechanisms.
questions.hint: Think about the mechanism that produces this split.
